The question is decidable for this class, but Delta doesn't implement the algorithm (equivalence of DCF languages). Use a bounded check.

## Example

```delta error
dpda D {
  start q0
  accept q0
  q0 -0, ε → A-> q0
}
lang L = D
check L ≡ L
```
